svg.text: I_try = I(k−1) + Ki × e(k) × Δt u_try = Kp × e(k) + I_try
u = clamp(u_try, −900, +900) I = 条件积分
Kp=2.0 ‰/rpm · Ki=0.5 ‰/(rpm·s) · i_limit=500‰ · duty_limit=900‰ · 斜坡 600 rpm/s
